purpose: Requirements for the orchestrator pattern in forge skills: delegating detailed work to agents, collecting results by return value, and the shared completion flow.
summary: Background: the God-Skill problem of context consumption, degraded instruction following, no parallelism and lost intermediate results
FNC-001: user-invocable skills are orchestrators that manage progress, branching and dialogue and delegate detailed work
FNC-003: reference documents given to agents must be self-contained and placed in the plugin docs directory
FNC-004: independent steps run in parallel, results return as return values, and prompts carry only paths and structured arguments
FNC-005: document format selection, JSON for machine-parsed plans and Markdown for requirements and designs
FNC-006: common completion flow of review, ToC update and commit for document generating skills
FNC-007: user input is interpreted by the AI and not by argument-parsing scripts
Applicability table of data hand-off methods per skill
tasks: Designing or revising a forge orchestrator skill
Deciding what to delegate to agents versus keep in SKILL.md
Designing parallel agent execution and result collection
Writing reference documents consumed by agents
Choosing JSON or Markdown for a generated document
Implementing the completion flow of start-requirements, start-design or start-plan
Reviewing skills for orchestrator pattern compliance
title: REQ-001 オーケストレータパターン要件
